_comment: THE ROOM TYPES, for the De'vyora Library's Theme -> Room hierarchy.
This file is the single source of truth, in the same way shared/themes.json is for
themes. backend/src/services/rooms.service.ts reads it so uploads, browsing and the
Drive folder names all agree on one list.
THEY ARE THE SYSTEM'S OWN ROOMS, NOT A NEW PARALLEL LIST. Every entry here already
exists in the two places that matter downstream: `wizard` is the label the mood-board
wizard uses (frontend/mood-board.html, ROOMS), and `space` is the key Python's
Keeping them tied is what lets a client pick a Kitchen reference and have the board
come back a kitchen -- if these drifted apart, a reference would say one room and the
`slug` names the Drive sub-folder under the theme, and the starter image file.
`aliases` carry the free text that reached the old `room` column before this list
existed, so an older row still lands in the right place instead of being orphaned.
`outdoor` marks a space with no ceiling and no walls to speak of: a parapet, the sky
above it and a floor. The starter generator draws it differently for that reason, and
the reading a starter ships says 'parapet' where an indoor one says 'walls'.
Python holds 'balcony' and 'patio' as two entries matched on substring, with balcony
first; one room here covers both, as the wizard does, and points at that first key.

bathroom.label: Bathroom
bathroom.blurb: Full bathroom, with a walk-in shower zone.

bedroom.label: Bedroom
bedroom.blurb: The bed against its feature wall, quiet tones.

drawing_room.label: Drawing Room
drawing_room.blurb: Drawing or living room — seating facing a media wall.

powder_room.label: Powder Room
powder_room.blurb: Compact vanity, basin and mirror. No shower.

kitchen.label: Kitchen
kitchen.blurb: A run of counter, cabinets, and the splashback between.

balcony_patio.label: Balcony & Patio
balcony_patio.blurb: Open to the sky — a parapet, a railing and an outdoor floor.
